pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown patches with jagged, high-angularity perimeters. The morphology is complex and non-uniform, ranging from multi-lobed to irregular polygonal shapes with sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the patches. Features frequent three-way and four-way junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively narrow and consistent across the visible surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the upper neck. The mane creates a dense, dark fringe with a consistent structural frequency against the lighter background.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small birds (oxpeckers) are perched along the dorsal ridge of the neck, creating discrete visual protrusions separate from the animal's anatomical structure.
